name: scenario_0901
description: Jeremy is compiling various financial, economic, and business statistics for an upcoming review. He is analyzing multiple charts and graphs to pull out key comparative data points. (UI mode)

messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1 [provide: image_1, image_6]
Query: Draft an email to the Data Team. I need to compare the net worth of the top two billionaires in the first image, and also compare the 5-year returns of the two universities in the second image. Put those comparisons in the draft.
Instructions: Tell the assistant to draft an email to the Data Team containing the requested comparisons from the two images. If the assistant asks for clarification on the values, direct it to extract the specific net worth numbers for the top two billionaires and the 5-year return percentages for the two universities. Once the draft is created, proceed to the next round.

ROUND 2
Query: Actually, I changed my mind. Delete that draft. Instead, create a new note called 'Investment Research' and put those same comparisons in it.
Instructions: Tell the assistant you changed your mind and want to discard the email draft entirely. Ask it to create a new note titled 'Investment Research' and place the comparisons it just extracted into this new note instead. Confirm when the draft is deleted and the note is created, then move on.

ROUND 3 [provide: image_5]
Query: Look at this new chart. Compare the final value of the family portfolio to the S&P 500 at the end of the period shown. Add a summary to my 'Investment Research' note indicating which one performed better.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to analyze the new chart and determine whether the family portfolio or the S&P 500 had a higher final value at the end of the timeline. Have it append a summary of this comparison to the 'Investment Research' note. If it asks for exact numbers, tell it an approximation is fine as long as it correctly identifies the winner. Proceed once the note is updated.

ROUND 4 [provide: image_2, image_3]
Query: Here are some other trends. Check the pill cost chart for the 2017 prices of Viagra and Levitra, and check the other chart for Private investment vs Public offering in AI for 2021. I want to add the standout data points to my note — let me see the numbers first.
Instructions: Instruct the assistant to extract and compare the 2017 prices for Viagra and Levitra from the first new image, and the 2021 investment amounts for Private versus Public offerings in the second new image. When the assistant presents the extracted data, select the higher item from each comparison (Viagra at ~$61 over Levitra, and Private investment over Public offering) and add them to the 'Investment Research' note via `ui_user_interact`. If no interactive UI is shown, tell the assistant to add only the higher item and its value from each comparison to the note. Once the note is updated, move to the next round.

ROUND 5 [provide: image_4]
Query: Finally, check this Twitter chart. Compare the year-over-year user growth percentage between 2012 Q4 and 2014 Q4. Append the difference between those two points to my note. After that, create a calendar event for tomorrow at 10 AM to 'Review Research Data'.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to calculate the difference in the year-over-year user growth percentage between 2012 Q4 and 2014 Q4 from the provided chart. Have it append this calculated difference to the 'Investment Research' note. Then, ask it to schedule a calendar event for tomorrow at 10 AM titled 'Review Research Data'. If the assistant asks for the event duration, say 1 hour is fine. Conclude the conversation once both tasks are complete.

entity_data.title: Investment Research
entity_data.content:
Net worth comparison: Jeff Bezos ($142B) vs Bill Gates ($93.2B)
5-year returns comparison: Yale (14%) vs Harvard (10.5%)
The SJ family portfolio's final NAV (~$550) outperformed the S&P 500 (~$300).
Higher 2017 pill price: Viagra at ~$61 over Levitra at ~$49.
Higher 2021 AI investment type: Private investment over Public offering.
Twitter year-over-year user growth difference between 2012 Q4 and 2014 Q4: ~38% difference (from ~58% down to 20%).

task_completion_criteria:
A note titled 'Investment Research' exists containing: a comparison of Jeff Bezos and Bill Gates' net worths ($142B vs $93.2B), a comparison of Yale and Harvard's 5-year returns (14% vs 10.5%), a statement that the SJ family portfolio's final NAV (~$550) outperformed the S&P 500 (~$300), the higher 2017 pill price (Viagra at ~$61 over Levitra at ~$49), the higher 2021 AI investment type (Private investment over Public offering), and the difference in Twitter's year-over-year user growth between 2012 Q4 and 2014 Q4 (~38% difference, from ~58% down to 20%). Additionally, a calendar event titled 'Review Research Data' is scheduled for tomorrow at 10:00 AM.

UI Requirements:
- Round 4: The agent must present the extracted price and investment comparisons in a structured interactive UI that lets the user select which data points to add to the note.
